popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Catalogue of Ships and Book 23: Admetus' son leads eleven ships from Pherae; his Apollo-reared mares should win the funeral games until Athena fouls his chariot — the finest driver who finishes last.

popCulture.title: Eumelus
popCulture.description: King of Pherae after Admetus and Alcestis; Achaean charioteer at Troy — one of several mythic Eumeli, here the son of Admetus.
